Package org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.core.evaluate.expression.tree

Class ExpressionPrinter

java.lang.Object
org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.core.evaluate.expression.tree.ExpressionPrinter
public final class ExpressionPrinter extends Object
Pretty-prints expression trees, such as item => item.size() > 3. Operators are named, and written as methods, as described in OperatorNames. Choices are printed as c ? a : b, operator values as (+) or (reduce).

    • printExact

      public static String printExact(Expression expression, ValueDeseralizationContext values, IntFunction<String> labels, Function<String,it.unimi.dsi.fastutil.ints.IntList> labelIds, IntFunction<IValueType<?>> refTypes)
      Print the given expression in the text form that ExpressionParser reads back into the same expression. In contrast to print(org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.api.evaluate.expression.tree.Expression, java.util.function.IntFunction<java.lang.String>, java.util.function.IntFunction<org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.api.evaluate.variable.IValueType<?>>), values are not shortened, parameters are written with their types, and references only use a label if that label leads back to them.
      Parameters:
      expression - An expression.
      values - For serializing values that are written with their type, such as items.
      labels - Resolves the label of a variable id, may return null.
      labelIds - Resolves the ids of the variables with a label.
      refTypes - Resolves the type of a variable id, may return null when unknown.
      Returns:
      The text.
